idea: diversifier basket: weak survivorship-free sleeves that each failed the strict rule alone but were positive in every period; combined at equal risk they may add what none adds alone
candidate_pool: every survivorship-free sleeve (BTC/ETH only, macro data, or a point-in-time universe) registered since Gen334 that was positive in all three periods of its own test: Gen345 A stablecoin mint shock, Gen346 A Coinbase hourly premium (BTC/ETH), Gen376 N2 stablecoin impulse, N3 fee pressure, N4 Bybit crowding, Gen374 crash 8h on the point-in-time top-60
selection_rule: recomputed here on 2022 / 2023-24 / 2025-26: kept if positive in all three periods AND |daily corr with K1| < 0.3 AND pairwise corr with an already kept member < 0.7 (kept in the listed order)
construction: equal risk by 2022-24 daily sd, one sleeve 'diversifier basket' added to K1 (portfolio_v5 weighting as for every sleeve)
pass: strict rule vs K1 (2022-26 +0.05, every period not lower)
honesty: the pool is selected on full-period signs of earlier tests, so the basket is optimistic; it counts as 1 trial here and the members' trials are already counted
